title: Rebuild planned: a hybrid recommender
summary: The 2023 app took about a minute per request. The rebuild keeps the same Goodreads data but precomputes a hybrid of similar-book neighbors and an ALS taste model, so recommendations come back in milliseconds.

title: Ranked list and predicted ratings
summary: Recommendations became a single ranked column with a large rank and a predicted-rating box, plus how readers like you rated each book and a sort by predicted rating.

title: Stricter Goodreads import
summary: Title-only matches were pairing newer books with unrelated older ones, so a title match now has to match an author too. Re-imports replace earlier ones, and any book can be removed.

title: Explore, Your books, map view and About
summary: Added a catalog-wide Explore page, a map of recommendations by popularity and rating, reading insights on Your books, and an About page with the math and links to the code.

title: Click-to-filter and a filter bar
summary: Clicking an author, genre or tag filters the list, a filter bar shows what's active, and the filters were reorganized for genre, tags, year, rating and popularity.

title: Live on Cloud Run
summary: Deployed to Google Cloud Run, scaling to zero when idle, with a $5 budget alert. Box sets now rank below the books they contain in search.

title: Stable ranks and calibrated predictions
summary: Ranks keep their numbers under filters, predicted ratings are calibrated to each reader's own scale, and For you skips books predicted well below the reader's average (about a 4% accuracy cost).

title: Young adult books hidden by default
summary: Recommendations leave out young adult books (main genre YA, or at least 22% of readers' genre votes) unless you tick a box, which re-ranks the whole list.

title: Homepage refresh and cover wall
summary: A simpler homepage, with a hand-picked cover wall that's half literary fiction and half popular titles.

title: The AI Assistant
summary: A Claude-powered reading assistant that uses the recommender as tools, searches the web for books after 2017 and talks books. Haiku handles simple messages and Sonnet complex ones, within daily caps.

title: A boost for well-known books you'd love
summary: Best match now lifts famous books with high predicted ratings, so a classic like The Green Mile isn't buried (#384 → #96), while obscure books with high averages don't jump the queue.

title: More honest predicted ratings
summary: Book averages are now shrunk toward Goodreads-wide averages, and predictions are stretched only as far as your own ratings support. Average error fell from about 1.0 to 0.88 stars.

title: Portfolio repo reorganized
summary: The portfolio's folders are numbered so Shelf Life comes first on GitHub, and the root README follows the same order.

title: Demo library and cover-flow transition
summary: "See a demo" loads a real 772-book Goodreads library. Going to recommendations plays a short animation of your favorite covers, then your top picks.

title: An always-warm server
summary: One Cloud Run instance now stays running, so a first visit after a quiet spell loads in under a second instead of an estimated 5–15.

title: Phone menu, tooltips and a plainer About
summary: On phones, the nav collapses into a menu. Nav links got short tooltips, the About page dropped engineering trivia, and the cover flow got varied pause points instead of bunching up.

title: A logo and favicon
summary: The name Shelf Life stayed after a brainstorm of alternatives, and the site got its book-and-worm logo and a matching favicon.

title: An open build log
summary: Every prompt that shaped the product, Claude's replies, the decisions and the commits are logged in the repo and shown on this page, and they update automatically from now on.

title: A time-based evaluation harness
summary: Each held-out reader's most recent ratings, by the date they read each book, are now hidden and predicted. On 5,895 test readers Shelf Life scores NDCG@10 0.067, 66% above the best 2023 method and nearly 3x popular books, and it's recorded as the champion to beat. A leakage check found held-out ratings in the item means, and the pipeline now excludes them.

title: Re-tuned for recent taste
summary: Under the new evaluation the taste model was overweighted for long reading histories, and old reads counted as much as recent ones. Capping the taste model's share at 40% and weighting recent reading more (using the reading dates from a Goodreads import) raised NDCG@10 on test readers from 0.067 to 0.087, about 30%.

title: An Evaluation page
summary: A new page charts every model version on the same test readers, from launch (NDCG@10 0.064) to recency weighting (0.087), with what changed and the commits behind each step, and lists every evaluation report with the champion's first.
